propositions: Data Center backend has no value-pinning characterization suite, only shape assertions in test_backend_contract.py that would pass with every value wrong
The shared outbound_mapper.py is not exercised through WikiTextCodec, leaving DC composition regressions undetected
DC's _map_local_to_dc_fields must be parametrized alongside Cloud's to pin priority/status/type maps, sanitizer boundaries, identity labels, and probe branches by exact value rather than shape

DC probe branches cannot be pinned through the _backend() seam because FakeTransport.probe_remote unconditionally returns UNREACHABLE; they must be pinned via JiraDataCenterTransport or classify_probe_response directly

DC must be verified to bind its own configured resolved_statuses rather than Cloud's, testable only with a non-default set since DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES
